name: heroui
description: 🚀 Beautiful, fast and modern React UI library. (Previously NextUI)
readme: HeroUI (previously NextUI) is a production-ready React component library that combines the accessibility rigor of React Aria with the utility-first styling of Tailwind CSS v4. It ships a clean compound component API (Card.Header, Card.Content, Select.Item, …), requires no wrapper, and works out of the box with React 19 and Next.js.
